overview: A contemporary portrait around five women ready to do anything in the face of extreme situations such as extortion, oppression, deceit, exclusion or manipulation in a single shared universe articulated around five conflicts that will develop like a butterfly effect – one as a consequence of the other – and so on to shared catharsis.
title: Furia

overview: Beloved funeral directors, husband-and-wife team Francis and Kaiora Tipene embark on a new travel odyssey, witnessing life and death traditions from Tonga, Japan, India and more.
title: The Casketeers: Life and Death Around the Globe

overview: Vendetta follows the underworld investigations of ex-mafioso turned mafia-hunter Danny Scipio.
title: Vendetta

overview: Teva Royer, a police lieutenant in Cayenne who is close to his feelings and without a filter, trusts his instincts blindly. Raised in a village in the heart of the Amazon, he survived alone in the jungle for seven months when he was just a child. No one knows what happened during those long weeks, but since then, no emotion, no hesitation, no movement escapes Teva.
title: A l'instinct

overview: Pick Me! is a gameshow with a difference. This raucous, fun-packed show has all members of the audience shouting "Pick Me!" because anyone our host, Stephen Mulhern, chooses will come down and play. It's a fast-paced, game of wits with lots of chances to win.
title: Pick Me!

overview: "WOOBINDA - ANIMAL DOCTOR" is an Australian series that primarily showcases the Australian bush, countryside, and its captivating wildlife. The story revolves around a veterinary surgeon who lives near an unnamed country town called Gatten's Creek. The series features appealing human characters, led by the titular animal doctor, John Stevens (played by Don Pascoe), along with his assistant, Peter Fischer (played by Lutz Hochstraate), who is of German descent. John Stevens has a teenage daughter named Tiggie (portrayed by Sonia Hoffman) and an adopted Aboriginal son, Kevin (played by Bindi Williams). He is also supported by an elderly retainer, Jack (portrayed by Slim De Grey). In keeping with television tradition, John Stevens is a widower, continuing the familiar trope in such series.
title: Woobinda

overview: Gaute redefines himself as an investigative journalist. He digs into sandboxes, drains and why people don't like him.
title: Gautes dokumentarprogram

overview: Ghost Hunters of the Grand River follows a group of Six Nations ghost hunters who have dedicated their very existence to gathering evidence from the world of ghost stories, paranormal encounters and the unexplainable.
title: Ghost Hunters of the Grand River

overview: Lorraine Kelly presents a topical mix of entertainment, discussion and showbiz glamour as well as the latest fashion, food and celebrity gossip.
title: Lorraine

overview: An Ghig Mhór celebrates the joy of putting on your first big hometown gig. In each episode, a renowned Irish musician mentors an up-and-coming band and helps them to organise their first big gig in their hometown. From the sitting room to the stage, the series follows the bands as they attempt to find a venue, sell tickets and deliver the performance of a lifetime. An Ghig Mhór provides a platform to new emerging Irish bands and shines a light on the hard work, creativity and dedication that goes into putting on your own gig.
title: An Ghig Mhór

overview: It's time for a Reality Check! Join hosts Starr McGowan and Adrian Konarski every Friday for your bite-sized weekly roundup of everything jaw-dropping, binge-worthy and straight-up chaotic in the world of reality TV. We'll have you up to date on all the goss in no time.
title: Reality Check

overview: To avoid being unfairly accused of murder and to improve his reputation, police Major Alexei Gorbatov, nicknamed Gorbaty, agrees to lead an experimental police unit consisting of former prisoners. These criminals have specific skills that are useful for infiltrating the criminal environment without the need for a long cover. In the process of completing tasks, the Hunchback is faced with a difficult moral choice and the need to control dangerous subordinates who can break down at any moment and let him down.
title: Опасный

overview: A man who walks the spirit world and a court lady who hears the dead enter the East Palace by the king's orders — can they unravel its dark secrets?
title: The East Palace

overview: Notorious serial killer Lee Ren-yao receives an interview from a documentary crew, triggering a string of mysterious events tied to a buried past.
title: Had I Not Seen the Sun

overview: Star chef Giada De Laurentiis has cooked in countless kitchens worldwide. To her, the kitchen is the heart of the home. Giada will team up with A-List designer Erik Garcia to surprise a deserving family with the kitchen makeover of their dreams. Their combined expertise leads to kitchens that are as beautiful as they are functional, transforming the lives of these families forever.
title: Giada In My Kitchen

overview: This series shows in a new and imaginative way how over the past 40 years in Britain extreme money and hyper-individualism came together in an unspoken alliance. Together they undermined one of the fundamental structures of mass democracy - that it could create a shared idea of what was real. And as that fell apart, with it went the language and the ideas that people had turned to for the last 150 years to make sense of the world they lived in. As a result, life in Britain today has become strange - a hazy dream-like flux in which no one can predict what is coming next. While distrust in politicians keeps growing. And the political class seem to have lost control.
title: Shifty

overview: Evelyn & Noah navigate through 3 lifetimes to unearth the truth about their destiny with Warrick and Siena, but their efforts to flee the dying world become complicated when Cain, an immortal, decides to hunt them down.
title: We Were Tomorrow

overview: When Song Qiyue returns from abroad, her dream homecoming collides with a harsh reality: inheriting a failing homestay on the brink of collapse. Teaming up with Gu Ci'an and his friends, they wage a revolution in hospitality. From financial disaster to unexpected triumph, their journey proves that the greatest rewards aren't just profit, but passion, purpose, and the power of belonging.
title: Love Blossoms with the Wind

overview: A provocative look at the worlds of horseracing and gambling, told through a diverse group of characters surrounding a California racetrack. The series centers on an intuitive tough guy named Chester "Ace" Bernstein, who has always been involved with gambling, from bookmaking and money laundering to casino operations. Recently released from prison after three years, he teams with Gus Economou, his longtime chauffeur and muscle, to craft a complex plan involving the Santa Anita Racetrack in California. As they plot out Ace's strategy, the pair recruits Turo Escalante, a successful trainer with a sordid reputation. In the meantime, an old trainer nurtures a possible breakthrough thoroughbred, while a ragtag group of four racetrack groupies band together to try to catch lightning in a bottle – as winners of an elusive Pick Six bet.
title: Luck

overview: Four in a Bed is a British reality television game show that has been airing on Channel 4 since 22 November 2010. The show involves four B&B owners, who take turns to stay with one another - and pay what they consider fair for their stay. The winner is the establishment named best value for money.
title: Four in a Bed

overview: Telling the story of the events that develop when three unfamiliar families start living together, Family Felicity will bring family relationships, confrontation with the past and bonds of love to the screen with a humorous language.
title: Aile Saadeti

overview: Chen Tianshuang, having seen his buddy die right in front of him, chooses to leave the National Security system and become a humble fishmonger. However, he is recalled and sent to Taiwan, China, to infiltrate the local gang and uncover the smuggling routes. Upon arriving in Taiwan, China, he quickly adapts to the local lifestyle and social circles. Yet, the brutal gang wars and the harsh reality of his undercover mission are quietly looming ahead...
title: Faith & Fire

overview: After becoming a top pilot, Ruan Sixian reunites with Fu Mingyu as love, ambition, and misunderstandings test their bond.
title: Blossom through the Cloud

overview: Roma and Anya were married for about five years, the candy-bouquet period was replaced by the harsh everyday life of family life. They realized that they had to move on, but in different directions. However, their mutual friends — young parents Katya and Lyosha, as well as bachelors Oleg and Elya — disagree with their decision to divorce, because Roma and Anya are the core of their party, without them the company will fall apart. Dinners together, trips to nature, shared birthdays — all this may come to an end. But Roma, apparently, has not cooled his feelings for his ex-wife. The casual phrase "I don't like it, let's get divorced" turned his usual lifestyle around. Anya alone, feeling free, plunges into the maelstrom of new relationships and tries to find herself in this world.
title: Остаться друзьями

overview: Shocking tales of betrayal and murder.
title: The Killer You Know

overview: Get ready for Celebrity Puzzling, where your favourite celebrities battle tricky puzzles in a showdown of logic, speed and sheer determination. Hosted by the ever-charismatic Jeremy Vine, every night sees quiz queen Carol Vorderman and beloved actor Sally Lindsay lead two celebrity teams into a battle of mind-bending puzzles and challenges. But who will crack the code and claim victory, and who will be left scratching their heads at the back of the class?
title: Celebrity Puzzling

overview: Dispatches is the British TV current affairs documentary series on Channel 4, first transmitted in 1987. The programme covers issues about British society, politics, health,religion, international current affairs and the environment, and often features a mole inside organisations under journalistic investigation.
title: Dispatches

overview: The mischievous daughter of the Underworld King nearly brings chaos to the Netherworld after devouring all the Yin energy. As punishment, the King sends her on an adventure in the human world.
title: The Reaper Princess Saves the Day
Shi Ba Sui Tai Nai Nai Jia Dao, Chong Zheng Jia Zu Rong Yao

overview: To succeed as a singer, Natasha sold her soul to Count Vladimir Polanski who, when discovering her love story with Jonas in a past life, began to chase them.
title: Vamp

overview: Tommy and Tuppence are a detective duo for the ages. They fall in love, fall out of it, and tumble back in, all while solving some thrilling, entertaining mysteries along the way.
title: Agatha Christie's Tommy & Tuppence

overview: The story revolves around the conflicts between the families of Silvana and Oliva, mother and paternal grandfather who fight for custody of Zeca after the death of the child's father.
title: Vereda Tropical

overview: It is the story of a tender little girl who is separated from her mother after losing her memory in an accident. Isabel, known as "Chispita," is taken to an orphanage and later adopted by a widowed businessman to brighten his daughter's life. This radical turn of events will completely change our protagonist's life.
title: Chispita

overview: The series deals with topics relating to pets and animals in human hands. In each program, owners of pets or exotic animals as well as experts such as animal trainers, animal photographers, zoologists or scientists are visited. The special features and characteristics of the species, the requirements for keeping them and the particularities of caring for them are discussed with them. There are also practical tips on animal-friendly husbandry and/or product tests for pets in service articles.
title: hundkatzemaus

overview: With exclusive access to some of the most experienced High Court enforcement bailiffs and repossession teams in the country, this series is an eye-opening insight into cash-strapped Britain from the perspectives of debtors, creditors and debt collectors. It reveals what it means to be a creditor who cannot get back what they are owed, what it is like to be saddled with debt that you are simply unable to repay and what it takes to be the kind of person who can pay but refuses to do so. Cameras capture the daily hassle of dealing with violent confrontations, tearful debtors, downright liars and genuine cases of hardship. Then there are the debtors, many of whom have some distressing tales to tell of how they got into the situation in the first place. No one wants their possessions confiscated, after all. The result is a unique insight into one of the biggest issues facing those who cannot afford to keep paying the bills.
title: Can't Pay? We'll Take It Away

overview: Andrea Celeste tells the story of a fifteen-year-old girl whose mother has disappeared. Her life unfolds between a orphanage and a wealthy home that adopted her, but where she is not loved.
title: Andrea Celeste

overview: It's winter in the Algarve and little is happening. But, in the shadows, a Real Estate Fund is buying the entire island of Faro to build a luxury resort there. However, an unexpected obstacle appears: Zé Maria, an old fisherman, owner of a famous beach restaurant, refuses to sell, under the influence of his daughter, Ana Cristina, who, in the meantime, returns from Switzerland. And his example is followed by other inhabitants of the island.
title: Faro

overview: The director of the Tula Youth Theater arranges a truly fiery premiere... and ends up in prison for setting fire to the theater. The only way to get out early is to stage "Romeo and Juliet" by assembling a troupe of prisoners and guards. The irreconcilable enmity between the two clans turns the rehearsals into absurd skirmishes, and the stage into a battlefield. In addition, Shakespeare gives a chance for freedom not only to the director, but also to the new actors who are secretly planning an escape.
title: Театральная зона

overview: Hopelessly optimistic but eternally single, 30-something Amanda decides to break her celibacy streak and throw herself into dating.
title: Halva Malmö består av killar som dumpat mig
Eat, Sleep, then Wait for Happiness

overview: Starting with the corruption case in Ningzhou, this story follows Ye Qinglan, the daughter of a disgraced official now enslaved after her family's downfall, and Shen Que, the young lord of Xuan Manor who operates in secrecy to investigate the truth. Together, they embark on a thrilling journey to unravel a dangerous conspiracy.
title: Spring Fever

overview: Documentary series following the work of groundbreaking police teams around the UK as they confront the problems of troubled communities.
title: Neighbourhood Blues

overview: Orphaned in the chaos of the Republican era, Laifu survives a "fox spirit massacre" and hones his mystical skills in a derelict temple, becoming a wandering mystic. A decade later, his quest for vengeance begins with the "Weasel Immortal Wedding" case, entangling him with the enigmatic Miss Bai and her wealthy family's intrigues. As bizarre cases plague Harbin, Laifu joins forces with the resolute Inspector Gu to investigate. A shocking revelation at the Bai family reunion exposes the true mastermind behind the "grey immortal" possession. The very traitor murdered his master! Together, they dismantle the Bai family's sinister fortune-altering array and uncover a traitorous scheme involving a troupe leader colluding with the Japanese. Justice is served, but Laifu forsakes his newfound wealth for a life on the road. Both the willful Miss Bai and the spirited Inspector Gu choose to accompany him, transforming the Five Immortals Conspiracy into a tale of chivalry, where the end of one blood feud marks the beginning of new bonds...
title: Tales of Five Immortals

overview: The plot centers on Leonel Carranza, a landowner whose kindness has been eclipsed by betrayal. After his wife's abandonment and his daughter's tragic death in a fire, Leonel seeks revenge. Convinced that Alba Palacios and her family are responsible for the tragedy, he forces her into a loveless marriage.
title: Amanecer

overview: Maria do Carmo makes a fortune with her father's business and becomes a successful businesswoman, but maintains the habits of her humble past.
title: Rainha da Sucata

overview: Lie Detector: Truth or Deception examines individuals long suspected of serious crimes who voluntarily submit to taking a polygraph test hoping to clear their names in the eyes of their family and community. Award-winning investigative journalist Tony Harris hosts, bringing critical context and analysis drawn from his background in criminal justice reporting, and the results of a professionally administered lie detector test by George Olivo, Former FBI agent and veteran polygraph examiner.
title: Lie Detector: Truth or Deception

overview: Nishina, Maya, Shiro, and Aoi are four good friends in their second year of high school with good looks but disappointing personalities. The four who decided that they will never fall in love, formed their own club, known as the "Muda-bu" (Useless Club), which focuses on researching silly themes and uploading them on social media. One day, they decided to do an experiment from a manga that says, "If you run with a piece of bread in your mouth and bump into someone, you will fall in love". While trying to conduct the experiment, they accidentally bumped into someone while having a piece of bread in the mouth.
title: Koi ni Mudaguchi

overview: After discovering that Emmanuel Mijares has died, Daniela, Dulce, Yuri, and Lupita are summoned to a mysterious mansion. Forced to interact, the tensions between them quickly ignite, and the lies they've been hiding for years come to light. But little by little, these women begin to question themselves, to reflect, and to realize that they share much more than they ever imagined.
title: Mentiras, la serie

overview: This series retells intriguing true crime stories of families gone wrong – when divorce is just not enough, when problem parents must be silenced forever, when offspring become too much.
title: Deadly Kin

overview: Catch Me If You Can is a gripping true crime documentary series that delves into the chilling world of murderers who eluded capture, meticulously planning their crimes, and engaging in psychological warfare with investigators. Each episode takes viewers on a rollercoaster ride as they follow the pursuit of a different elusive killer, exploring the intricate mind games they play to outsmart those tasked with bringing them to justice. In this true crime docuseries, the focus is very much on the chase. With a blend of first-hand accounts, expert analysis, and stylized recreation, this series offers an unprecedented look into the methods and systems used by the police to finally capture these murderers.
title: Catch Me If You Can

overview: Series which reveals the extent of fake goods in the UK and investigates the conmen who are trying to get their hands on your money & first aired on BBC, 1 March 8, 2010. Each weekday episode last 45 minutes, but the BBC show a 30 minute reduced episode on Monday nights at 19:30.
title: Fake Britain

overview: Ueda Itsuki is a 39-year-old single pharmacist. She had landed the job she wanted, enjoyed romance, and lived a peaceful life. However, her long-time boyfriend, Sawada Masakazu, got engaged to another woman... Sawada was someone Itsuki truly loved, but she couldn't express her feelings honestly and couldn't blame him so she wouldn't be hated. One day, on the way home from a drinking party with her colleagues, a younger man, Matsushige Eito, appears in front of Itsuki, and they suddenly start living together. Then she meets Sato Kohei, a medical representative who gives her peace of mind with his straightforward love and kindness... She starts to realize the true meaning of her happiness and the importance of being loved by someone, and something begins to change inside Itsuki...
title: I Want You to Say I Love You

overview: California Avenue is a story brimming with humour and love. Set in a secluded canal-side caravan park deep in the luscious English countryside, its peace is irrevocably disrupted by the arrival of Lela and her 11-year-old child, both on the run, looking for refuge in this hidden world. It is here that a fractured family will come together, ghosts and demons will firmly be put to rest and an unexpected love is forged.
title: California Avenue

overview: The story is about Chinese students at the prestigious Ivy League college. The efforts they made to get accepted, when just being gifted students isn't enough; their experiences, struggles, relationships, and the blend of Chinese-Western cultures while studying there. Gu Nian planned to study abroad because she wanted to be with her foreign boyfriend for a long time. Without any experience in studying abroad, she enrolled in a studying abroad agency, LZ, on the net but had a dispute with the company's owner, Lin Yao, and her boyfriend, Zhuo Peng. The reason was that Lin Yao took Gu Nian's order even though the company was short of staff. Zhuo Peng, who was a legal entity but did not work in the company, was forced to become Gu Nian's temporary tutor and helped her become a university student. Shortly afterwards, Lin Yao and Zhuo Peng broke up. Zhuo Peng was hired as a psychological counselor at the University of A. He found that the international student community has some psychological, life, and academic problems due to the uncomfortable environment. That's why Zhuo Peng set up a free consultancy service to help students find the right school for them. This goal also coincided with Gu Nian's. In the end, they became partners and a couple.
title: Dream Beyond

overview: Squatters are taking over homes across the country and Flash Shelton is the man who gets them out. With bold tactics and street smarts, Flash and his team face tense and sometimes dangerous situations to help families reclaim their property. Each episode reveals the emotional and high-stakes battles where the fight for justice can quickly escalate, putting everyone involved at risk. This is the struggle to take back what rightfully belongs to them.
title: Squatters

overview: Monty Don explores the fascinating history and evolution of the British Garden, from the 17th Century through to the Modern Day. Monty's journey will take him to the most famous garden s of the nation, including Ham House, Rousham House, Kew Gardens and Rodmarton Manor in Gloucester. Monty also visits the fabled gardens of Number 10 Downing Street, where the most powerful leaders of the world have walked.
title: The Secret History of the British Garden

overview: The world's first documentary that closely follows the real faces of ATEEZ.
title: ATEEZ 8 FACE

overview: In this show, the actors try to renovate and redesign a home with the external appearance of a building site to make it more attractive. In doing so, they take the renovation work into their own hands and become active as craftsmen.
title: Ab in die Ruine!

overview: A young doctor, convicted of murder, joins forces with his friends from the orphanage to prove his innocence and expose a syndicate that is framing innocent people.
title: Aybsiz

overview: A group of passionate anglers from the UK push their skills to the limit in six epic locations around the world. In each place, they face challenges for which they need to combine their own talents with local techniques to outwit the environment they find themselves in. The series explores the incredible world of fishing, looking at its variety of fish and their behaviour in distinct environments, and revealing surprising animals and stunning landscapes.
title: Earth's Wildest Waters: The Big Fish

overview: Pınar, from a traditional family, tries to build an independent life in Istanbul while working as an assistant brand manager at a food company. Though she seems strong, she quietly longs for love, a promotion, and to discover her true self.
title: Modern Kadın

overview: Prince, a superstar in the entertainment industry, proudly comes out as LGBTQ and finds great success in her career. But everything changes when he suddenly wakes up in a past life—as Khun Worradej, a young man forced to hide his true identity in a time when same-sex love is forbidden. Prince must navigate palace intrigue, political betrayal, and uncover the mystery behind Worradej's past and his secret lover. On the journey, he encounters King Chaiyachet, a young monarch facing an assassination plot, and Mom Kosol, the king's older brother who holds a hidden truth tied to Worradej's heart. Prince must protect them both while challenging unjust laws against same-sex love amidst betrayal, rebellion, and the struggle for power.
title: I'm the Most Beautiful Count

overview: Having previously held a leadership role on the London Games of Twenty Twelve and a spell in W1A as the Head of Values at the BBC, Ian Fletcher is now bound for the greatest stage in world football. Next year's tournament will be the biggest ever. Hosted by the USA, Canada, and Mexico with 48 countries taking part and 16 venues thousands of miles apart across the whole of North America; what could possibly go wrong? Ian Fletcher is about to find out, as he joins the Twenty Twenty Six Oversight Team in Miami as its Director of Integrity.
title: Twenty Twenty Six

overview: Linda P has invited 5 of Denmark´s funniest comedians on a holiday in sunny Marbella. Along she brings a suitcase with embarrassing ammunition from the comedians ‘past. Every evening, they take turns in the hot seat to get roasted by their colleagues. It´s a war of words with lots of surprises and laughs - because how far can you really go when it comes to jokes?
title: Roasted: Verdens Sjoveste Ferie

overview: Die Lottosieger (English: Lottery Winners) is an Austrian comedy television series. It was produced from 2008 to 2011 and broadcast from 2009 to 2012 on ORF 1. Die Lottosieger is about a family, that, over night, becomes rich, by winning the lottery.
title: Die Lottosieger

overview: Kristoffer Appelquist has invited five of Sweden's funniest comedians to his luxury villa in Cyprus. During the daytime, they soak up the sun and enjoy the pool, but in the evening, things heat up as the guests, one after another, must take their place in the hot seat and get roasted by their friends. The last of them is the host, only to decide then who has become the best roaster of the season.
title: Roast on the Coast - Sverige

overview: Six Norwegian comedians have packed their bags and traveled to Cyprus for a week of sun, swimming - and roasting! Each night, a new comedian will take the hot seat to have their life torn apart by the other comedians before the best roaster of the night is crowned. On the final day of the stay, the week's best roaster and the winner of Roast on the Coast -Norway will be announced.
title: Roast On the Coast - Norge

overview: A comedy series about saving family relationships. The lives of Andrei and Kristina Konovalov have long been mired in the mundane, losing their vibrant colors, and the family hearth has completely extinguished. At the suggestion of friends, the couple turns to sex coach Boris and enrols in the course 'Sexual Resurrection'. During the training, Andrei and Kristina immerse themselves in experiments that seem strange, amusing, and some even frightening, pushing them out of their comfort zone. During the 'resurrection' process, the couple realises that their intimate life is just a small part of the puzzle, and the real problem of their faded relationship lies much deeper.
title: 50 оттенков брака

overview: Sybylla is a shockingly modern young woman with one searing ambition - to be a writer, while her family is determined to marry her off. With an irrepressible taste for fun, Sybylla breaks every convention of 1900 Australia as she searches for a story that will allow her to write her way to independence. For her, the choice between adventure or marriage seems easy, until she falls in love. Will Sybylla marry, or will she risk it all for a creative life?
title: My Brilliant Career

overview: Top End Bub revisits Lauren, a dynamic Indigenous lawyer ticking off life goals in Adelaide. She's married to Ned, a handsome husband who makes fresh croissants. What else could a person need? After Lauren's eight-year-old niece is orphaned, the show follows the couple reluctantly abandoning their big-city goals and moving to the Top End (where the outback meets the tropics) to raise the child. While Lauren and Ned juggle the responsibility of becoming unexpected parents and try to keep their marriage together, Lauren must come to terms with her responsibilities within her culture as she transforms from an individualist to the linchpin of her family.
title: Top End Bub

overview: A woman wrongfully convicted for drug possession seeking refuge and falling in love with a solitary inmate with a rumoured brutal murder charge.
title: ClaireBell

overview: A series of documentaries looking at the connection between science fiction and science fact.
title: Future Fantastic

overview: For a long time, many species have been so scarce that they are hardly ever seen. Humanity has wiped out over fifty percent of all mammals, birds and fish in as many years. Across Europe, efforts to restore the balance of ecosystems damaged by the human footprint are now seeing returns of many wild animals close to extinction. But not everyone is happy with their return.
title: Naturen vender tilbake - rewilding

overview: Game show with Bernd Stelter, in which celebrities from North Rhine-Westphalia are tested on their knowledge of their own federal state.
title: Das NRW-Duell

overview: Válótársak is RTL Klub's own Hungarian television series from 2015, based on the Dutch RTL series titled Divorce. It tells the story of three men going through a divorce - Bálint, Dávid, and Joci - who, while experiencing the sometimes painful, sometimes joyful adventures of starting over, become best friends. Bálint Sáfár (András Stohl), Dávid Jakab (Péter Scherer), and Joci Hatvani (Tamás Lengyel) are the best of friends. Not only do they live together as adult men, but they also share the fact that all three are currently in the middle of a divorce.
title: Válótársak

overview: Hill, a former bullied boy with a geeky personality, finds love and confidence from "Yuka" in the female character romance simulation game "Yuka! Love Me Please" and grows into a handsome programmer beyond recognition. Hill achieves his dream of getting a job at the company that developed "Yuka! Love Me Please", where he meets Junji, the perfect, cold-hearted CEO from Japan. Soon after getting the job, the company announces that it will be ending service for the game, leaving Hill dejected. Seeing his passion to move forward despite his heartache, Junji approaches Hill with a proposition.
title: Dating Game

overview: When two women plot to end an abusive marriage through murder, an unexpected visitor arrives — threatening to shatter everything they've carefully planned.
title: As You Stood By

overview: If you remember our podcast "This is the signal", then it's the same format, only now you can also watch the episodes. If you don't remember, we're envious that this is the first time you'll hear science journalist Ivan Shunin and N+1 editor—in-chief Alexander Dubov discuss science fiction in every sense with a specially invited guest and find out how science fiction is scientific.
title: Три сигмы
